text.name: tp_tip_autosave
text.text: Write modSettings/TornadoPhysics_Config.xml automatically when this panel is closed and something was changed.

text.name: tp_info_instant
text.text: Changes apply instantly, exactly like the t_ console commands.

text.name: tp_note_key
text.text: Open this panel any time with the Tornado Control Panel key (rebind under Controls).

text.name: tp_note_mp_admin
text.text: Multiplayer (admin): gameplay changes are sent to the server and apply to every player.

text.name: tp_note_mp_client
text.text: Multiplayer: showing the server's settings. Only the host or a server admin can change gameplay; sound, ring, map overlay and debug are yours.

text.name: tp_confirm_reset_physics
text.text: Reset the physics settings to factory defaults? This is saved immediately.

text.name: tp_confirm_reset_tuning
text.text: Reset the tuning values to factory defaults? This is saved immediately.

text.name: tp_confirm_reset_cargo
text.text: Reset the cargo settings to factory defaults? This is saved immediately.

text.name: tp_confirm_reset_husbandry
text.text: Reset the husbandry settings to factory defaults? This is saved immediately.

text.name: tp_confirm_reset_traffic
text.text: Reset the traffic roadblock settings to factory defaults? This is saved immediately.

text.name: tp_confirm_reset_climate
text.text: Reset the real-life climate settings to factory defaults? This is saved immediately.

text.name: tp_confirm_reset_all
text.text: Reset ALL settings to factory defaults? This is saved immediately.

text.name: tp_tip_climate
text.text: On: each tornado's EF rating, size, hail and wind follow real recorded statistics for the region (mostly EF0-EF1, EF4-EF5 rare). Off: classic mode, every size equally likely and random storm weather.

text.name: tp_tip_climate_region
text.text: Which region's tornado statistics to use. Auto: the base US map uses US-wide data, a mod map whose name contains a state, province or country uses that region, other maps keep the classic roll.

text.name: tp_seasons
text.text: Real seasons and time of day

text.name: tp_tip_seasons
text.text: Tornadoes come in the region's real tornado months and mostly in the late afternoon. The map's overall tornado rate is kept (see Tornado frequency).

text.name: tp_tip_direction
text.text: Natural tornadoes travel the way they do in the region (in the US mostly toward the north-east). The console spawn still aims where you look.

text.name: tp_tip_outbreaks
text.text: With the region's real odds, a touchdown can start a busy storm day: more tornadoes follow 30-120 in-game minutes apart, until the limit below or 22:00.

text.name: tp_tip_frequency
text.text: Multiplier on how often the map produces tornadoes in real-life mode. 1x = the map's own rate.

text.name: tp_tip_outbreak_max
text.text: Most tornadoes one outbreak day can bring, the first one included.

text.name: tp_note_climate_missing
text.text: Climate data (DB/TornadoClimate*.xml) not found - classic mode only.

text.name: tp_note_classic
text.text: Classic mode: every tornado size is equally likely.

text.name: tp_note_no_region
text.text: No climate data for this map's region yet - pick a region above, classic roll used until then.

text.name: tp_tip_radius
text.text: Base radius of the tornado. Changing it re-rolls the tornado size / EF rating.

text.name: tp_tip_power
text.text: Force used to throw objects out of the funnel.

text.name: tp_tip_heavy
text.text: Mass (tons) above which a vehicle is treated as heavy.

text.name: tp_tip_dmg_in
text.text: Damage per second applied inside the core.

text.name: tp_tip_dmg_out
text.text: Damage per second applied in the outer winds.

text.name: tp_tip_outdoor
text.text: Damage vehicles that are standing outside.

text.name: tp_tip_indoor
text.text: Damage vehicles parked inside sheds as well.

text.name: tp_tip_lift_bales
text.text: Let the tornado pick up bales and pallets.

text.name: tp_tip_lift_logs
text.text: Let the tornado pick up logs.

text.name: tp_tip_border
text.text: Stop physics near the map edge so nothing is thrown off the map.

text.name: tp_tip_fence
text.text: Safety distance from the map border where physics stop.

text.name: tp_tip_chaos
text.text: Randomness factor for movement. Higher is more violent.

text.name: tp_tip_max_speed
text.text: Physics speed cap for lifted objects.

text.name: tp_tip_destruct_ratio
text.text: Share of the radius that counts as the destructive core.

text.name: tp_tip_purge_time
text.text: How long each ejection phase lasts.

text.name: tp_tip_siren
text.text: Play the tornado siren when a storm spawns.

text.name: tp_tip_ring
text.text: Draw the red danger-zone ring around the tornado.

text.name: tp_tip_fire
text.text: On: damaged engines have a 50/50 chance to catch fire. Off: every damaged engine burns.

text.name: tp_tip_destruction
text.text: Vehicles caught in the storm lose parts (auto-repaired after 24 in-game hours).

text.name: tp_tip_recovery
text.text: Charge an itemized tow and repair bill when a tornado-damaged vehicle is reset to the shop. Saved immediately.

text.name: tp_tip_money_scale
text.text: Scales everything Tornado Physics charges, like the emergency tow bill. It is also adjusted automatically to the savegame's economic difficulty (Easy costs less than Hard).

text.name: tp_tip_mapui
text.text: Show the tornado stats widget on the ESC map.

text.name: tp_tip_mapui_sel
text.text: Only show the overlay while the tornado hotspot is selected.

text.name: tp_tip_cargo
text.text: Trailers caught in the storm dump their contents.

text.name: tp_tip_spill_height
text.text: Minimum lift height before cargo starts to spill.

text.name: tp_tip_spread
text.text: Radius of the spilled cargo piles.

text.name: tp_tip_leak
text.text: Chance (0-1) for covered trailers to leak or pop open.

text.name: tp_tip_cargo_verbose
text.text: Detailed cargo debug output in the log.

text.name: tp_tip_husbandry
text.text: Tornadoes can kill animals in pastures that are not strictly indoors.

text.name: tp_tip_immunity
text.text: Immunity time for a pasture after it was hit, for a 2 km map. Bigger maps scale it up (4 km = 2x, 8 km = 4x).

text.name: tp_tip_traffic
text.text: AI road traffic and pedestrians stop and wait (like at a red light) before entering the tornado. Cars and people already inside the zone leave it.

text.name: tp_tip_traffic_buffer
text.text: How far outside the tornado's outer radius cars and pedestrians stop. Turn on the danger ring (Effects tab) to see the roadblocks as red posts (yellow for pedestrians).

text.name: tp_tip_wildlife
text.text: Birds, deer, boar and other wild animals run or fly away from the tornado; animals it catches vanish. The farm dog runs home to its doghouse.

text.name: tp_tip_wildlife_distance
text.text: How far outside the tornado's outer radius animals start to flee.

text.name: tp_tip_hazards
text.text: Weather can hurt your crops: long dry spells cause drought damage, heavy rain on soaked soil floods low-lying fields, and during a hot drought ripe fields can catch fire. Crop damage needs the game's disaster destruction setting. Off while FS25_RealisticWeather is installed.

text.name: tp_tip_hazards_drought
text.text: Long hot dry spells dry out the soil; growing crops then lose a little more every day until it rains. Rice paddies are spared.

text.name: tp_tip_hazards_flood
text.text: Several hours of heavy rain on already soaked soil flood the lowest-lying growing fields: water pools at each field's lowest point and drowns the crop there. Rice paddies are spared.

text.name: tp_tip_hazards_fire
text.text: During a drought, on hot dry afternoons, a ripe grain-type field can catch fire. The fire spreads inside the field and burns the crop until it burns out or rain puts it out. Marked on the map.

text.name: tp_tip_insurance
text.text: Per-farm insurance against tornado and weather damage: monthly premiums, claims and payouts, with the rules and prices of the map's country. Policies come in a later update; this switch prepares the system.

text.name: tp_tip_insurance_admin_only
text.text: OFF: each farm's managers (and the server admin) buy, change and cancel their farm's policies. ON: only the server admin does - for servers where the admin runs the insurance.

text.name: tp_tip_insurance_region
text.text: Whose insurance rules and prices apply. Auto detects the country (and state or province) from the map.

text.name: tp_msg_ins_payout
text.text: Insurance: %s paid out to your farm.

text.name: tp_msg_ins_off
text.text: Insurance is turned off on this server.

text.name: tp_msg_ins_denied
text.text: Insurance: only a farm manager or the server admin can change this farm's policies.

text.name: tp_msg_ins_denied_admin
text.text: Insurance: on this server only the admin manages policies.

text.name: tp_tip_hazards_owned
text.text: ON: drought and floods only damage fields a farm owns; fields nobody owns stay untouched. OFF: the weather hits every growing field on the map.

text.name: tp_tip_hazards_intensity
text.text: 100 % = mild: a long drought then costs a field about 15 %. Higher values hurt more.

text.name: tp_tip_hazards_frequency
text.text: How fast the soil dries out in warm weather. Higher = more and longer droughts.

text.name: tp_tip_hud
text.text: Physics telemetry labels over every tracked object.

text.name: tp_tip_pos
text.text: Log the tornado node coordinates in real time.

text.name: tp_tip_verbose_all
text.text: Master switch. Also sets the destruction and physics channels.

text.name: tp_tip_verbose_destruction
text.text: Save / load / repair logging of the destruction module.

text.name: tp_confirm_kill_test
text.text: Run the husbandry kill test? Animals in every outdoor pasture within 60 m of you WILL be killed.

text.name: tp_msg_touchdown
text.text: ALERT: TORNADO TOUCHDOWN! (EF-%d | Radius: %dm | Power: x%.1f)

text.name: tp_msg_outbreak
text.text: TORNADO OUTBREAK (%s): up to %d more tornadoes possible today!

text.name: tp_msg_dry_spell
text.text: DRY SPELL: soil moisture is down to %d %%. Crops will suffer if it stays dry.

text.name: tp_msg_drought_start
text.text: DROUGHT! The soil has dried out - growing crops are suffering.

text.name: tp_msg_drought_damage
text.text: DROUGHT DAMAGE: %d of your fields lost crop today.

text.name: tp_msg_flood
text.text: FLOODING! Heavy rain on waterlogged ground has flooded %d low-lying fields.

text.name: tp_msg_flood_damage
text.text: FLOOD DAMAGE: %d of your fields are under water.

text.name: tp_msg_field_fire
text.text: FIELD FIRE on field %s! The dry crop is burning.

text.name: tp_msg_fire_out_rain
text.text: The rain has put out the fire on field %s.

text.name: tp_msg_fire_out
text.text: The fire on field %s has burned out.

text.name: tp_msg_drought_end
text.text: The drought is over - rain has refilled the soil.

text.name: tp_msg_outbreak_one
text.text: TORNADO OUTBREAK (%s): one more tornado possible today!

text.name: tp_msg_storm_damage
text.text: STORM DAMAGE: %s (%s) lost %d animals! Safe for %d seconds.

text.name: tp_msg_tow_bill
text.text: EMERGENCY TOW: billed %s (tow %s, %d broken parts, vehicle value %s)

text.name: tp_msg_tow_bill_engine
text.text: EMERGENCY TOW: billed %s (tow %s, %d broken parts, vehicle value %s, engine work %s)

text.name: tp_map_line
text.text: EF:%d Wind:%d-%d mph Radius:%d m Distance:%s
